text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After Loves Only You finished training and I was about to head home from the academy—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Less of leaving something behind, and more of forgetting something? I forgot to take a video of your run."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
See, we've been doing it every once in a while, right?
The 'Watch Me Train' viewing session!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Some people are happy to see me being serious, while others offer their feedback,
so it's really meaningful, you know?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: And so, let's go for some extra training!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's show them a run full of fighting spirit!
That'll lead to overwork, so let's do something else.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, now they're all fired up too!
We're gonna get some great shots♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll give it my all and blow all the members away♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Then how about a dinner intro video?
Everyone's curious about what athletes eat, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And the one who's gonna prepare it is Trainer-kun!
Heheh, thanks for the treat~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And the one who's gonna prepare it is Trainer-chan!
Heheh, thanks for the treat~♡
